## Download

| | File | For |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Installer** | **EasyWriter-Setup.exe** | Most Windows PCs. Run it and follow the steps. |
| **Portable** | **EasyWriter-Portable.zip** | PCs that block installers, such as school computers. Extract it and run `EasyWriter.exe`. |

Windows may say it protected your PC, because EasyWriter is not code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
The other files are for automatic updates, so you don't need them.
